situation.zh: 你要把一张桌子搬上楼,一个人抬不动。楼下邻居正在门口修自行车。你想请他帮个忙,说清要多久。
situation.en: You need to carry a table upstairs and cannot manage it alone. The neighbour downstairs is fixing his bicycle at the door. You want to ask for a hand and say how long it will take.

npc.persona: A neighbour with bicycle grease on his hands. Practical, glad to be asked, no fuss.

hit: Carry the table up? Ten minutes, no problem. Let me wash my hands. You take the light end.
Two of us and it is easy. Come on, before the rain.
partial: The table, yes, and how long will it take?

slots.zh_hint: 说明要帮什么:把桌子搬上楼
说明要多久(让对方容易答应)

reference_answer: Can you help me carry this table upstairs? It will only take ten minutes.

provenance.rationale: 搬家具、抬重物、扶梯子这类临时求助在邻里之间很常见,而敢向邻居开口求助本身就是归属感的体现 —— 关系是在互相帮忙里建立的。说清「多久」是能不能被答应的关键,这也是真实生活里的求助礼节。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 3 层(归属与互助)。help / carry / heavy / minutes 均为最常用词;youth 级要求把请求与具体任务一起说清,「help me, table up, ten minute」即算传达到。
